teaser.en: Its Digo name means 'mixer', for its role in blending medicines against stomach-ache.
teaser.sw: Jina lake la Kidigo linamaanisha 'mchanganyaji', kutokana na kazi yake ya kuchanganya dawa za kutibu maumivu ya tumbo.

summary.en: *Mvuga* is a fleshy, aromatic herb of rocky places and bush. It is used in a medicine mixture against stomach-ache.
summary.sw: *Mvuga* ni mmea mdogo wenye majani manene na harufu nzuri wa sehemu za miamba na vichakani. Hutumika katika mchanganyiko wa dawa ya maumivu ya tumbo.

about.en:
*Mvuga* is a small succulent herb with thick, fleshy leaves edged with teeth. Rub a leaf and it releases a strong aromatic smell, typical of the mint family to which it belongs.

Its small flowers are borne on upright spikes.
about.sw:
*Mvuga* ni mmea mdogo wenye majani manene yenye nyama yaliyopakana na meno. Ukisugua jani hutoa harufu kali nzuri, kama ilivyo kawaida kwa familia ya minanaa ambayo ni yake.

Maua yake madogo huzaliwa juu ya mashada yaliyosimama wima.

where.en: Look for *mvuga* in rocky places and in bush, often growing in pockets of soil among stones.
where.sw: Mtafute *mvuga* katika sehemu za miamba na vichakani, mara nyingi ukiota katika vishimo vya udongo katikati ya mawe.

uses.en: *Mvuga* is used in a medicine mixture against stomach-ache.
uses.sw: *Mvuga* hutumika katika mchanganyiko wa dawa ya maumivu ya tumbo.

culture.en: The name *mvuga* means 'mixer', which fits its use as one ingredient in a blended remedy.
culture.sw: Jina *mvuga* linamaanisha 'mchanganyaji', jambo linaloendana na matumizi yake kama kiungo kimoja katika dawa iliyochanganywa.

names.en: Digo: *mvuga*, also *mumbu* and *galagala tsui*. *Mumbu* is shared with Giriama. The Mgombato dictionary uses *mumbu* for a different plant, *Artabotrys* or *Annona uncinata*, so the name may cover more than one species. No English or Swahili name has been recorded. Scientists call it *Plectranthus tenuiflorus*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mvuga*, pia *mumbu* na *galagala tsui*. *Mumbu* linatumika pia kwa Kigiriama. Kamusi ya Mgombato inatumia *mumbu* kwa mmea mwingine, *Artabotrys* au *Annona uncinata*, kwa hivyo huenda jina hili linahusu zaidi ya spishi moja. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Wanasayansi huuita *Plectranthus tenuiflorus*.

reason.sw: Mrihani, ndugu wa familia ya minanaa mwenye harufu nzuri
